description: This file defines a REST API class for handling advanced data types in the Superset project, including endpoints for retrieving available data types and converting data types based on passed arguments.

classes.name: AdvancedDataTypeRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class for managing advanced data types, providing endpoints for listing types and converting data types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the /convert endpoint, returning an AdvancedDataTypeResponse based on input arguments.

methods.name: get_types
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the /types endpoint, returning a list of available advanced data types.
